notes.title: Update 1.03 and reduced price! Happy Halloween.
notes.content:
Santa needs your help to deliver to some very spooky houses. Jack-o-Lantern hijinks abound in this new list of deliveries. Are you ready for the horror, the laughs, and the frustrations? We certainly hope so.

Additionally, Secret Santa is now reduced in price 33% lower than the original retail price!

notes.title: Small Halloween update on its way
notes.content: Since it's hitting the annual Holiday gauntlet, we decided to partake in the steam staple of Halloween themed updates. It's friday the 13th, and it would only be fitting we tried a Halloween update for a Christmas themed game(it just felt right). The new Halloween list should be open to play right off the bat, so you don't need to unlock anything to play it. Currently the update is on the beta branch for now while we test the one achievement for finishing the list, but after doing so, it should be available in the main branch. I hope you all enjoy this small update, and wish you a pleasant October.

notes.title: The Secret Santa 1.01 update is now live.
notes.content:
Featuring WSAD movement and full controller support, as well as preliminary Linux support; we bring you the first official update for Secret Santa. It's been a pleasure to bring this game to the Steam community, and we're continuing to improve Secret Santa. 

Coming soon to the Beta branch for review: Full touch screen controls, Steam cloud support, and more. Ho-ho-ho!

*Note: Due to stability issues between the game engine and some graphics drivers, the Steam overlay might not appear in Linux, though achievements will work as normal.

notes.title: Beta Branch: New update featuring WASD and gamepad support plus new updates on the way.
notes.content:
Well, it's been 2 weeks since the release of Secret Santa, and I feel an announcement is overdue.

As you may have noticed in the headline above, we made a beta branch with an update featuring more control options for Secret Santa, along with some small tweaks here and there. We also have plans for mobile controls in the future, but we'll still need to test around with it before official release.

One final note. A new update featuring new music is also planned for later this month as well, but for now, I hope the present beta update makes things more welcoming to people still playing Secret Santa.

Thank you all for your support, and happy holidays.

To join the Beta branch, visit the Secret Santa Community Discussion.

tags.feature: - new music is also planned for later this month
